name: eas-observe
description: Use for anything related to EAS Observe - adding `expo-observe` to an Expo project (ObserveRoot/AppMetricsRoot, markInteractive, useObserve, ObserveInteractiveMarker, the Expo Router / React Navigation integrations for per-route metrics, the expo-image and Reanimated integrations, `Observe.logEvent` events, error reporting via ObserveErrorBoundary and `Observe.reportError`, native crashes, source map and iOS dSYM upload for symbolication, network traces, and config such as sampleRate, errorSampleRate and networkTraces), querying via the EAS CLI (`eas observe:metrics-summary`, `observe:metrics`, `observe:routes`, `observe:events`, `observe:session`, `observe:versions`, `observe:errors`, `observe:traces`, `observe:trace`, `observe:event`) or the Expo MCP `observe_*` tools, interpreting the results (cold/warm launch, TTR, TTI, navigation TTR, update download, and the TTI frameRate/device/network params for slow startups), or shipping an Observe integration inside a third-party package.
